mutation_rules.execution_layout: Copy base-pass/.seal into a newly initialized disposable Git repository, apply mutations, then run command.
mutation_rules.no_implicit_rehash: Unless rebuild_run_manifest is explicit, mutations intentionally leave the original manifest unchanged.
mutation_rules.rebuild_run_manifest: Sort verification evidence_files by POSIX path; record current raw-byte size and SHA-256; recompute evidence_sha256 over canonical JSON without created_at; manifest itself is excluded.
mutation_rules.set_raw_number: Parse the JSON object, set the pointer to a unique quoted sentinel, serialize with ensure_ascii=true, indent=2, sorted keys, and a trailing newline, then replace only that quoted sentinel token with either the exact ASCII literal or text repeated count times from the repeat spec; exactly one of literal or repeat is required.
mutation_rules.write_bytes_hex: Write exactly the bytes decoded from the lowercase hexadecimal string; do not apply text encoding or a trailing newline implicitly.
